summary: Full backend + frontend testing of KisanPulse. 13/13 pytest cases pass covering demo/state, prices, forecast (p10<=p50<=p90 + backtest mape lgbm/ets/snaive/ensemble), decide (5 pathways sorted by NRV desc, action==pathways[0].key, whatif price_shock lowers NRVs, wait_days stored), full lot lifecycle: POST /api/lots -> 3 offers within ~10s, below-MAV offer returns 409 BELOW_MAV without override, accept best -> tx stage 'accepted', 5x advance -> logistics_booked/in_transit/delivered/payment_released/closed, money-meter complete with realised.nrv and delta, audit has lot_created + 3x offer_received + offer_accepted + tx_closed. Frontend: Dashboard (all data-testids, commodity toggle switches Onion->Tomato price 2046->1555), Decide page (decision-hero, 5 nrv-rows, whatif-price-shock -10 updates delta table), Create lot -> LotPage polls, all 3 offer-cards appear, offer-below-mav visible, clicking accept on below-MAV opens mav-override-dialog, 'Accept best offer' creates transaction-timeline, tx-advance-button advances 5 times then disappears, money-meter-realised + money-meter-delta shown, audit-ledger shows 12 events. Pulse map with nashik marker, Console backtest-table 5 rows, /lots + demo-reset-button clears lots.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first render before container measures — cosmetic only, chart displays correctly after mount

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: verify APScheduler offer scheduler (10-20s) uses jitter that doesn't exceed default poll timeout in UI (~25s target from spec). Observed: all 3 offers arrived well within 30s in preview env.
Recharts container should set explicit min-height to avoid initial width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on dashboard render.
Consider excluding Mongo _id in any raw-document endpoints (audit ledger returns fine — payloads are dict strings, no _id leaks observed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, full lifecycle e2e works)

seed_data_creation: Test created ephemeral lots via POST /api/lots then called demo/reset via UI button at end
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py has 13 tests: TestMeta (8), TestDecide (3), TestLotLifecycle.test_full_flow (1 large end-to-end). Full lot lifecycle takes ~15-30s due to offer scheduler wait. Forecast first-call for new commodity/market can take ~20s (increase timeout). Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and all critical elements expose data-testid; commodity-toggle-{onion|tomato|soyabean}, offer-card-{0,1,2}, offer-below-mav-{idx}, tx-advance-button, money-meter-realised/delta, audit-ledger, pulse-marker-nashik, backtest-table, demo-reset-button.
